For U8, refactor Go samples to use idiomatic Go practices (e.g., error handling, naming conventions).
assumptions: The protos/utils directory contains only utility functions and no generated code.
Kafka health checks in the master branch are compatible with Fabric 1.4 LTS.
The read-only invoke method will be implemented as a separate chaincode function.
Docker network configurations for U6 will not require additional port mappings.
Go samples are currently non-idiomatic and require refactoring.
